verdict.rationale: Lorikeet explicitly documents auditing knowledge bases at scale to find gaps and quality issues, and its simulation/replay tooling surfaces knowledge gaps by replaying historical tickets and synthetic scenarios to project resolution quality before deployment. Coach's Ticket Quality Score also reviews 100% of conversations to catch fumbled answers and feed fixes back. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the gap-detection accuracy and no explicit mention of detecting 'conflicting' content specifically (only gaps/outdated/quality issues).
